title: Implement health/medical characteristic mappings (K.3.3)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, health/medical characteristics:

- Heart Rate Measurement 0x2A37 -> 3346/5700, /min
- Temperature Measurement 0x2A1C -> 3303/5700, Cel
- Intermediate Temperature 0x2A1E -> 3303/5700, Cel
- Weight Measurement 0x2A9D -> 3322/5700, kg
- Body Fat Percentage 0x2A9B -> 26250/5700, %
- Body Mass Index 0x2A9C -> 26250/5701, kg/m2
- Blood Pressure Measurement 0x2A35 -> 3323/5700, Pa (with mmHg->Pa conversion)
- Glucose Measurement 0x2A18 -> 3325/5700, kg/L
- SpO2 0x2A5F -> 3325/5701, %
- VO2 Max 0x2A96 -> 26258/5700, mL/kg/min
- Resting Heart Rate 0x2A92 -> 3346/5701, /min
- Aerobic Threshold HR 0x2A7F -> 3346/5702, /min
- Anaerobic Threshold HR 0x2A83 -> 3346/5703, /min

~13 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.3
